items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to notification levels of emerging contaminants
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S6655

 TITLE OF BILL :

An act to amend the public health law, in relation to notification
levels of emerging contaminants

 PURPOSE :

To require the Department of Health to post on its website information
relating to emerging contaminant notifications levels and educational
materials so that the information is easily accessible to the public
and public water systems.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section one amends subdivision 6 of § 1112 of the Public Health Law to
require that notification levels shall be made easily accessible to
the public through a link that is posted on the Department's website
and updated regularly.

Section two amends subdivision 7 of § 1112 of the Public Health Law to
require that until the notification levels are posted on the
Department's pursuant to Public Health Law § 1112 (6), the
Commissioner shall post the notification levels established by
Declaration on the Department's website so that they are easily
accessible to the public through a link.

Section three amends subdivision 9 of § 1112 of the Public Health Law
to require the Department to make educational materials available
through a link on the Department's website that is easily accessible
and requires that such link shall also include information relating to
notification levels established by Declaration pursuant to § 1112(7)
of the Public Health Law and by regulation pursuant to § 1112(6) of
the Public Health Law. This section also requires the Commissioner to
coordinate with the U.S. EPA to ensure that the information available
on the EPA's Drinking Water Watch website is available to public water
systems and that information available on the EPA's Safe Drinking
Water Information System is available to the public through an easily
accessible link on the Department's website and that the Department's
website and such links must allow the public to easily access various
information, to the extent practicable, relating to including water
systems.

Section four provides an effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :

As a part of the 2017-2018 FY enacted budget, the State made major
changes relating to water contaminants, specifically requiring the
Department to establish emerging contaminates and notification levels
for those emerging contaminants. The Department is also required to
develop education materials relating to emerging contaminants.

This bill requires the Department to make such educational materials
easily accessible on their website to both covered public water
systems and the general public. Moreover, this bill seeks to make it
easier for public water systems as well as the general public to
access various information by requiring the Department to have easily
accessible links on their website.

Many New Yorkers opine that finding information relating to the
state's water systems is difficult and that such information should be
more readily available. As a result, of the Department being required
to establish notification levels for any emerging contaminant, it is
important for the public to be made aware of such notification levels
through an easily accessible link on the Department's website. It is
also important that information relating to drinking water systems in
the state of New York be made more easily accessible for the public by
requiring the Department to have links to the EPA's Safe Drinking
Water Information System on their website.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

New bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

To be determined.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Directs the department of health to post on its website information relating to emerging contaminant notification levels and educational materials relating thereto.
